meta.note: Bands and durations come from the canonical library, which supersedes the scraped values. Funding RULES are not in here — the app reads them live from the governed rulebook so legislation is never baked into a data file.

index.note: Keywords come from each standard's published Knowledge, Skills and Behaviours where available, which is the vocabulary the role is actually described in. Standards without published KSBs keep a shorter summary index and will match less well — the app says so rather than hiding it.
